summary: Competitive intelligence dashboard for Assistedly.ai covering 11 AgeTech platforms. Data sourced via Firecrawl visual benchmarks and manual competitive audits.

features.name: AI-Powered Care Matching
features.description: Platforms like Honor and Papa use smart matching algorithms to pair caregivers with families. Lottie's concierge service provides curated provider shortlists.
features.recommendation: Enhance Assistedly's matching engine with AI-driven personalization based on care needs, budget, and location preferences.

features.name: Integrated Family Communication
features.description: Cubigo, Icon, and Kinto all provide dedicated family portals/apps for real-time updates, messaging, and care coordination.
features.recommendation: Build a 'Family Dashboard' feature with activity feeds, care updates, and direct messaging to differentiate Assistedly.

features.name: Mobile-First Care Documentation
features.description: August Health's Care Track and Birdie's mobile app enable real-time, bedside documentation reducing administrative burden.
features.recommendation: Explore a lightweight mobile companion for facility staff to update availability and respond to tour requests instantly.

features.name: CRM & Lead Management
features.description: WelcomeHome CRM provides senior-living-specific pipeline management, automated workflows, and predictive lead scoring.
features.recommendation: Integrate lead scoring into Assistedly's existing wizard to prioritize high-intent families for partner facilities.

features.name: Cost Transparency & Calculators
features.description: CareScout (Genworth) leads with regional cost data. Lottie provides detailed pricing across 4,000+ UK care homes.
features.recommendation: Expand Assistedly's cost calculator with regional benchmarking and 'value score' that factors amenities vs. price.

features.name: Companion Care Networks
features.description: Papa's $1.4B-valued 'Papa Pals' network provides vetted companions for transportation, errands, and social support.
features.recommendation: Partner with local companion services or build a 'trusted provider' marketplace for non-clinical support.

features.name: Medication Management (eMAR)
features.description: August Health and Birdie both offer electronic medication administration records with compliance tracking.
features.recommendation: Lower priority for Assistedly's consumer-facing product, but valuable for facility partners — consider white-label integration.

features.name: Caregiver Support & Coaching
features.description: Kinto offers 1-on-1 caregiver coaching, peer support groups, and educational libraries as an employee benefit.
features.recommendation: Add caregiver education resources and a 'Caregiver Stress Index' tool to increase engagement and return visits.

competitors.name: CareScout
competitors.notes: Owned by Genworth. High focus on regional cost transparency. Longstanding brand with extensive cost-of-care database.

competitors.name: SeniorCare.com
competitors.notes: Leads with instant wizard tools and aggressive SMS follow-ups. Strong conversion funnel with immediate engagement.

competitors.name: August Health
competitors.notes: Modern EHR/clinical platform for senior living operators. $44M total funding. Used by Sonida, Koelsch, Bickford. AI-powered service plans and voice charting.

competitors.name: Cubigo
competitors.notes: Community engagement platform with modular 'Cubes' for dining, activities, maintenance, and family communication. 500K+ users across 70+ partnerships.

competitors.name: WelcomeHome CRM
competitors.notes: Senior-living-specific CRM founded 2017. Bootstrapped to $3.5M ARR. 100% feature parity between mobile and desktop. AI predictive lead scoring.

competitors.name: Birdie
competitors.notes: UK-based home care management platform. $62.4M total funding. Certified B-Corp. 50K+ care professionals, 1,000+ agencies. eMAR, rostering, family app.

competitors.name: Lottie
competitors.notes: UK care home marketplace with 4,000+ vetted listings. Free concierge shortlist service. #1 Startup in 2025 Startups 100. WhatsApp-based care finding.

competitors.name: Papa
competitors.notes: Companion care platform valued at $1.4B. 'Papa Pals' network for transportation, errands, and social support. Integrated with Medicare Advantage and Medicaid plans.

competitors.name: Honor
competitors.notes: Unicorn home care network ($1.25B+ valuation). Acquired Home Instead in 2021 creating world's largest home care network. Smart matching, Family Room app.

competitors.name: Icon (Go Icon)
competitors.notes: Community engagement platform (formerly Caremerge). Serves 2,000+ senior living communities. Family app, dining management, EHR integration, digital signage.

competitors.name: Kinto
competitors.notes: Caregiver support-as-a-benefit platform. 1-on-1 coaching, peer groups, care plan builder. Backed by General Catalyst. Mobile-first empathetic design.

competitors.name: Assistedly
competitors.notes: AI-powered continuum dashboard for senior care search. Cultural affinity filters, family dashboard, comparison tools. Bootstrapped with zero institutional funding.
